current_decision.priority: Preserve the accepted single reference and develop explicit opt-in joint/history natural-law candidates; do not resume optimization of the accepted single model
current_decision.following_pair_pilot: V2 uses 12 coarse contexts, causal 3 s history and recording-balanced calibration of strength. Five validation recordings show positive supported-action log-likelihood gains; 0/3 rollouts complete 60 s. Research candidate only
current_decision.lane_extension: Opt-in conditional P(d|a,s), crossing-backed onset supervision with common 8 s label follow-up and causal geometry projections. Train median maneuver duration 5.8 s. Center-lane control observations fix phantom old-lane leaders. Both lane-pair marginal tilts and optional potential-leader mixture are trained/calibrated, with coupling refitted afterward. Single reference untouched
current_decision.lane_pilot: V8-V16 implemented and evaluated, none accepted. Feedback regressions depart road; damped mixtures can cancel too many onsets; startup-law and mode-memory candidates still collide. V15 restricted alongside support completes 3/3 with full H(v,g)=0.13760/0.27887 but excludes 75/381 train and 92/564 calibration true onsets. V16 tree onset lowers calibration NLL but completes 0/3. All 18 arm probability audits pass. Full candidate review and frozen-single regression retained
current_decision.temporal_pilot: State-matched V7 residual correlation 0.0032 versus highD 0.9870 at 95.43% overlap. V17 own-action-history candidate wrongly reweights fallback and completes 0/3. V18 retains fallback/empty-state laws and completes 2/3, but pooled diagnostic H(v,g)=0.16980/0.28836. V19 adds lagged leader action and completes 2/3 with failure-censored H=0.12349/0.25953; calibration likelihood does not improve over V18. Six arms/18 runs retained. History and scene probability audits pass, 82 tests pass, exact frozen-single regression unchanged. No accepted candidate
current_decision.surface_pilot: Response audit completed on all train/calibration records. Geometry check in record 01: 262461 same-lane leader pairs agree with dhw within about 0.01 m. Matched frozen-query fallback occupancy is far higher in simulation, but coarse-state/selection limitations prevent causal attribution. V20 trilinear probability interpolation with refitted following kernel completes only 1/3 in both arms; all failures retained. 63931 selected surface probabilities and full scene audits pass; 86 tests and exact original-single regression pass. Not accepted
current_decision.following_response_pilot: V21 fits two role marginals on both current states with exactly preserved action support, direct empirical state support and 3 s causal history. Equal-record train likelihood and calibration-selected shrinkage, followed by coupling refit. Five validation recordings improve supported marginal likelihood and relative acceleration mean, but fitted completes 2/3 and independent 1/3. Failure-censored H(v,g) 0.15603/0.22460 and 0.19465/0.18868 are not acceptance. All 51584 adjusted actions and physical replay contexts audited, 94 tests and exact original-single regression pass. Sparse provenance exactly reconstructs critical smoothed cells from only 1-3 neighboring source rows. Not accepted
current_decision.censoring_pilot: All train/calibration motion-risk rows audited: original 8 s follow-up retains about half the risk exposure and 381/804 train confirmed crossings. New motion initiation times competing crossing/return hazards retain visible intervals from censored motions; conditional independent censoring remains assumed. V22 fitted/independent complete 1/3 and 0/3. V23 deterministic conditional mean crossing-time duration completes 1/3 each. V24 adds existing direct-state phase/interaction support backoff, completes 2/3 each but failure-censored H(v,g) is 0.12580/0.30468 and 0.16711/0.23809. All 18 runs retained, 171790 scene units audited, 7625 decision steps exactly re-sampled, 158 maneuver durations reconstructed. 102 tests and final exact original-single regression pass. No accepted candidate
current_decision.target_front_pilot: V25 actual target-front mixture fitted and evaluated: fitted 0/3, independent 1/3. 110 tests, 2315 exactly resampled steps and all probability audits pass, but candidate fails collision gate. Original single reference unchanged. All failures retained
current_decision.context_pilot: On user instruction, joint-PMF fitting stopped. V26 binds (A, target front, target rear) at onset and preserves identity through completion, separately from dynamic pairs. Explicit progress-weighted incoming-leader PMF gives 1690 pre-center responses and 1069 outside-pair responses. Both arms complete 1/3. Broad resampling stopped when user requested collision-first iteration; independent review partial, fitted review not run. 117 tests were run before that instruction
current_decision.discrete_baseline: Current user-requested direction: 1 s simultaneous 33-action decisions; 1 s LC at a=0; adjacency rebuilt every second. 15 Hz direct/linear execution, not the Nature paper bicycle model. Separate 1 Hz highD lateral count artifact; frozen original reference retained. V27-V33 collision failures all preserved. V34 uses direct-count longitudinal backoff, distance-weighted same-context empirical lateral frequencies and EXPLICIT extra projected-1s feasibility support. It completes seeds 7/19/29 for 60 s, with 10/10/8 lane changes. Only after this collision pass, original 10 Hz/bin scoring gives H(v,g,rr)=0.16305/0.21005/0.12486, above required speed/gap targets. Binned train coverage suggests feasibility excludes 19/680 true onsets; exact raw coverage unresolved. This is a restricted development baseline, not accepted full highD law or exact paper replication
current_decision.next: V38 checks direct empirical support and 3 s causal history before matching, so independent-only pairs cannot block supported neighbors. Same single laws and fitted 1 Hz joint weights. Fixed seeds 7/19/29 all complete 60 s, H(v,g,rr)=0.16400/0.22306/0.11069, versus V35=0.16852/0.23607/0.10974. Speed/gap improve, rr worsens slightly. V36 uniform half dependence collides; V37 distance taper and V39 supported-half retained but not selected. No additional broad experiment batch planned. Full highD/long-run/D2RL claims remain outside this stage.

paper.title: Distributionally Consistent Simulation of Naturalistic Driving Environment for Autonomous Vehicle Testing

local_variant.simulator: self-written direct longitudinal dynamics and prescribed lateral path
local_variant.map: unbounded two-lane straight road; no SUMO map loaded
local_variant.claim: method-aligned highD two-lane native adaptation; not exact bicycle-dynamics numerical replication

training.source: complete train recordings, not selected scenarios or the 72-packet bank
training.moving_average_smoothing: width-3 frequency smoothing before normalization, with declared inevitable-state mask
training.lateral: four neighbor-context empirical models with maneuver-onset labels
training.fallback: IDM fitted on train highD instantaneous actions and stochastic MOBIL-inspired incentive hazard; not the complete MOBIL equation. Fit-at-boundary identifiability warnings and fallback usage recorded separately
open_details: range versus bumper-gap geometry and vehicle-length conversion
lane-change onset detection and exposure denominator
three-lane training context projection into the two-lane runtime
MA smoothing neighborhood and inevitable-crash exclusion definition

initialization.following_probability: estimate from train highD, with observation-censoring accounting
initialization.following_state: joint P(r,rr|v); upstream vehicle is the following vehicle
initialization.free_position_increment: d_obs+Uniform(0,d0), with the selected distance convention
initialization.trivial_collision_handling: reject and resample, count rejections; no hidden speed clipping

basic_empirical_evaluation.finite_road_replenishment: unbounded road with a finite initialized fleet; no deletion or arrival process. Full stationary traffic-stream claim not supported
basic_empirical_evaluation.reference_distributions: train empirical for stationarity development; existing heldout recordings for grouped generalization with usage history disclosed

stationary_optimization.order: after basic empirical baseline is measured
stationary_optimization.car_following: Closed joint target audit retained. Open-flow variant jointly optimizes fine FF and CF PMFs using full joint CF finite-volume balance and measured train-only context exchanges. Continuous subcell dynamics assume constant predecessor speed. Finite-trajectory balance bands are not an exact stationary proof
stationary_optimization.objective: minimal deviation from empirical F under the paper's Frobenius-norm formulation
stationary_optimization.solver_contract: Convex-dual simplex projection minimizes squared Frobenius. Open-flow policies retain full joint CF balance, not a speed-only surrogate. Explicit diagnostic candidate mode never denotes stationarity acceptance. Frozen FF-only table is retained separately from the jointly adjusted FF table. Offline balance acceptance does not open the long-run gate
stationary_optimization.predecessor_motion: Observed train-only stable-leader endpoint velocity increment estimates offline disturbances; no runtime future input and no subject-trajectory replay. Does not identify causal leader response to modified follower actions
stationary_optimization.balance_tolerance: Each cell: abs(observed next occupancy minus source occupancy) plus 2/source_pair_count. Invalid/collision destination has zero allowance. This is a declared finite-sample development budget, not a confidence interval
stationary_optimization.short_run_result: V3 completes 3/3 fixed seeds versus 2/3 Basic and FF-only, and 1/3 v2. At full-cohort 10 s V3 H(v,g,rr)=0.25595,0.45386,0.22278. Equal-exposure 10-30 s V3=0.22753,0.17515,0.15188 versus Basic=0.20391,0.21077,0.14022: gap improves but speed/rr worsen. V4 added-speed residual 4.268e-7 exceeds 1e-8 allowance and only 1/3 rollouts completes. No production acceptance
stationary_optimization.matched_window_contract: Half-open 0-10,10-30,30-60 s intervals; identical complete-exposure seed intersection across arms; disclose excluded seeds and temporal correlation. Original endpoint scoring retained
stationary_optimization.next_priority: Stationary variants retained as historical experiments; current priority is dual extension on the user-accepted empirical reference
